title: Critique: cosmopsychism faces a de-combination problem

statements.text: Cosmopsychism avoids combining little subjects, but faces the inverse problem: how the one conscious universe grounds the billions of separate human and animal subjects. A conscious universe with no conscious parts seems conceivable.

sources.quote: the cosmopsychist may face the inverse difficulty of the decomposition problem
Whereas micropsychism faces a 'combination' problem, cosmopsychism faces this 'de-combination' problem
